title: Viral Solid
lines: The overall strength of the Viral Solid is perfect for medium to light oil patterns.
The 1000 Abralon® polished finish gives the Viral Solid the easy length on almost any lane condition.
When looking for consistent performance, Hammer fans love the Vibe Core. This one is a proven winner.
The Violent Flip Reactive cover comes to you in a solid which gives you a stronger read of the mid-lane compared to the original Viral.
FACTORY FINISH 500 / 1000 Abralon® Polished w/Powerhouse Factory Finish Polish
BEST LANE CONDITION Medium to Light Oil
